common_checks.name: Frozen provenance
common_checks.check: Verify diagnosis protocol exact SHA, P3 NOPASS gate identity, P3 protocol, complete analysis/structure bindings, analyzer/source identity; source drift or mismatched complete markers fails before input use.

common_checks.name: Read boundary
common_checks.check: Source path audit must exclude graph/base/query vectors, validation/held-out and ANN. Target code alone may read strictly bounded pilot GT100 prefix and saved fit GT10; portal code reads saved metadata/count only.

common_checks.name: No gate or model mutation
common_checks.check: Output remains post-hoc descriptive, preserves P3 NOPASS, no confidence intervals/bootstrap/new threshold/seed/model/portal or auxiliary graph authorization.

common_checks.name: Completeness and preservation
common_checks.check: New exclusive output directory, INCOMPLETE until all required outputs bound, complete marker last, source/input binding retained; old output rejected and exceptions never report COMPLETE.

common_checks.name: Full family
common_checks.check: Both registered datasets, L64/128, all exact comparison/bin cells retained including empty groups; no best-bin/model selection or implicit filtering.

common_checks.name: Scientific counter semantics
common_checks.check: Exclude legacy Fast expanded/rejected/evicted zero sentinels; oracle counters available. Timing not used as Recall replicates, no cross-model paired wall claim.

target_generalization_checks.name: Physical GT bound
target_generalization_checks.check: Synthetic ivecs prefix with width100 per record, exactly 10000 records in actual mode; full first100-rank values SHA verification while metrics use only top10; never read byte beyond allowed prefix.

target_generalization_checks.name: GT rejection
target_generalization_checks.check: Wrong per-record header, truncation, rank99 byte tamper, duplicate top10 IDs, negative/out-of-range ID and prefix checksum mismatch fail; trailing records remain unread and do not affect prefix identity.

target_generalization_checks.name: Fit identity
target_generalization_checks.check: Fit rawGT10 SHA and shape20000x10 match fit manifest and P0 fit identity; all rows unique IDs, no pilot GT in fit support. Count f(u) by query incidence.

target_generalization_checks.name: Exact targets
target_generalization_checks.check: All256 leaf counts descending with leafID tie, high IDs above63 and top4 zero ties; exact D and M4, histograms D1..10 and targetcounts0..10 with empty bins.

target_generalization_checks.name: Saved oracle integrity
target_generalization_checks.check: Recomputed full-GT regions and conditional weights match all four models, both L and both queues; common initial/no-search structures are kept separate.

target_generalization_checks.name: Denominators
target_generalization_checks.check: Separate all-node, seen/unseen unique-node populations from pilot targetslot weighted populations. Every fit target is seen; optional subgroup ratios use correct nonzero slot denominator or null.

target_generalization_checks.name: Movement
target_generalization_checks.check: pass1 move followed by pass2 return counts anypass changed but not final changed; final leaf/coarse change versus init explicit; lambda0-versus1 final difference explicit; no population dump.

target_generalization_checks.name: Additive subgroup contributions
target_generalization_checks.check: Use same full-GT top4 for seen and unseen; covered_seen/10+covered_unseen/10==M4 and hits_seen/10+hits_unseen/10==Recall exactly in integer-count form. Never independently reroute subgroups or allocate NDC to targets.

target_generalization_checks.name: Query strata
target_generalization_checks.check: k_seen exact0..10 all eleven bins, all10K queries exactly once; synthetic one-per-bin and empty-bin fixtures; slot-level seen/unseen counts consistent.

target_generalization_checks.name: All ten contrasts
target_generalization_checks.check: Original8 plus lambda1-minus-lambda0 oracle_unified under frequency3 andgreedy3; 2Ds*2Ls*10=40 contrast cells. Explicit candidate/reference signs, saved resultID-derived hits, wins/losses/equal, NDC/expanded deltas in every k_seen bin.

target_generalization_checks.name: Compact artifacts
target_generalization_checks.check: Fit20K/pilot10K perquery CSV or NPZ with hashes, enough columns for D/M4/support decomposition; no rawGT or million-node dump. Source permits one dataset independently but completion scope explicit.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Verification identity
portal_exposure_checks.check: Each saved perleaf verification binds proper same-lambda models/portals, candidate/query/cache evidence and analysis model identity; changed verification SHA or reordered incompatible leaf mapping fails.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Proxy denominators
portal_exposure_checks.check: Exactly256 leaves per structure. Delta=greedy_unionhits-frequency_unionhits, eligible target support is the proper perleaf cached denominator; negative deltas preserved and not converted to population Recall.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Fixed eight comparisons
portal_exposure_checks.check: Only greedy3-minus-frequency3 oracle_probability, 2Ds*2lambda*2L; do not compare cross-lambda proxy totals or select favorable portal model.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Actual entry classes
portal_exposure_checks.check: Use deduplicated actual ordered seeds including shared/default/anchor context. Exactly same ordered, same set changed order, or changed set; duplicate list/missingshared seed rejected.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Full route invariant
portal_exposure_checks.check: Same full ordered route plus fixed labels implies exact result IDs/order, Recall, NDC, expanded, rejected and evicted; any mismatch is integrity failure, not averaged-away noise.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Hidden route fields
portal_exposure_checks.check: Entry equality alone cannot permit changed regions, conditional weights, default or Fast anchor. Same-lambda expected region/weight identity checked independently of entry-class summary.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Result-set versus Recall
portal_exposure_checks.check: Changed top10 order, changed top10 set, Recall wins/losses/equal kept separate; equal Recall may conceal changed ID set, and same ID set may have changed order.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Exposure signs
portal_exposure_checks.check: Compute integer sum-delta sign independently of weighted delta/support score; sign of unweighted sum may differ from weighted score. Use saved conditional weights without re-normalizing supported leaves.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Empty proxy support
portal_exposure_checks.check: No division by zero or silent evidence fabrication. Document null/missing-support policy; positive-weight unsupported leaf should yield explicitly missing weighted score or an equally transparent predefined treatment. Zero-weight unsupported leaf has no weighted contribution.

portal_exposure_checks.name: Full paired summaries
portal_exposure_checks.check: All3 route classes and all3 sign classes including empty bins; counts exhaust10000 per cell, correct paired mean orientation, all oracle counters. Retain compact query-level outputs and binding.

expected: same entry set but changed order

exposure_zero_support_trap.forbidden: Silently divide0/0, infer zero effect, or renormalize remaining weights

synthetic_execution_status: Expected values independently derived; implementer functions not yet available or executed.
